terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms of Service govern your use of Lulu Island Flagship Cleaning Services and any reservation you make with us. We provide residential and light-commercial cleaning services in Richmond, Vancouver, North Vancouver, West Vancouver and UBC, British Columbia, Canada.

sections.heading: 1. Quotes and price hold
sections.body: A quote generated through our quote tool reflects a full price with no hidden fees, valid for a limited time window shown on screen. The hold extends automatically while you are actively completing checkout, up to an absolute cap. If your price hold expires before you confirm, you'll need to request a new quote.

sections.heading: 2. Reservation and payment authorization (Hold)
sections.body: When you confirm a reservation, we place a payment authorization ("Hold") to secure your booking. For card payments, this is an authorization hold, not a charge. For Alipay and WeChat Pay, the full service amount is charged upfront at booking. For PayPal (available only for first-time reservations), 50% of the Hold amount is charged as an advance at booking, with the remainder handled at service completion or according to our Cancellation Policy. A backup card is required to complete checkout with any payment method, to cover charges such as damage or approved extra time.

sections.heading: 3. Cancellations
sections.body: Cancellation windows and penalty amounts are set out in full in our Cancellation Policy, which is part of these Terms. By confirming a reservation, you agree to that policy.

sections.heading: 4. Identity and phone verification
sections.body: We require phone number verification before your first reservation can be confirmed, as a fraud-prevention and communication measure. This applies regardless of how you signed in (including social login).

sections.heading: 5. Eligible accounts
sections.body: Self-serve online booking is available for residential clients. Commercial (B2B) and government accounts, and reservations flagged for administrative review, are handled through a separate process and are not confirmed automatically through this checkout flow. New clients may hold one active reservation at a time until their first service is completed.

sections.heading: 6. Service documentation and quality
sections.body: Our team documents service completion with checklist photos, which also support our satisfaction guarantee and any warranty claim you raise about missed items. You'll receive a gallery of before/after photos after your service.

sections.heading: 7. Changes to these Terms
sections.body: We may update these Terms from time to time. Material changes will be reflected on this page with an updated date.

sections.heading: 8. Contact
sections.body: Questions about these Terms can be sent to hello@luluislandflagship.ca.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Lulu Island Flagship Cleaning Services collects, uses, retains, and protects personal information, in compliance with Canada's Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA) and applicable British Columbia privacy law.

sections.heading: 1. Information we collect
sections.body: Contact details (name, phone number, email); service address; photos taken during service checklists for quality control, and, where a warranty claim is opened, additional evidence photos related to that claim; payment method information — we do not store full card numbers ourselves; card payments and holds are processed and tokenized by Stripe, PayPal advances are processed by PayPal, and Alipay/WeChat Pay payments are processed through Stripe; your reservation and service history; and communications you have with our team.

sections.heading: 2. How we use your information
sections.body: To schedule and staff your service, verify your identity by phone (one-time code), authorize and process payment holds, captures, and refunds according to our Cancellation Policy, run quality control and resolve warranty claims, comply with legal and tax obligations, and, if you opt in, run our referral and Lulu Wallet programs.

sections.heading: 3. Retention
sections.body: Quality-control checklist photos are kept for 1 year from the service date. Photos tied to an open or resolved warranty claim/dispute are kept for 2 years and are never deleted while a related dispute remains open. If you request deletion of your personal information, your record is de-identified immediately and retained in a restricted, purge-eligible state for 2 years to meet our tax and legal record-keeping obligations, after which it is permanently purged.

sections.heading: 4. Your rights under PIPEDA
sections.body: You have the right to access the personal information we hold about you, request correction of inaccurate information, and request deletion of your personal information (subject to the retention obligations described above). To exercise any of these rights, contact us at hello@luluislandflagship.ca. Access and deletion requests are logged and are due a response within 48 hours of receipt under our internal service-level commitment.

sections.heading: 5. Breach notification
sections.body: If a data breach creates a real risk of significant harm, we will notify the Office of the Information and Privacy Commissioner for British Columbia (OIPC BC) and affected individuals within 72 hours of detecting the breach.

sections.heading: 6. Service providers and third parties
sections.body: We share the minimum necessary personal information with service providers who help us operate: Stripe (card payments, authorization holds, and refunds), PayPal (first-time reservation advances), Supabase (database and account hosting), and Sentry (technical error monitoring). Each provider is contractually and technically restricted to using your information to provide their service to us.

sections.heading: 7. Cookies and session data
sections.body: We use functional cookies and local session storage strictly necessary to keep you signed in and to operate the checkout flow. We do not use third-party advertising trackers.

sections.heading: 8. Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Material changes will be reflected on this page with an updated date.

sections.heading: 9. Contact
sections.body: Privacy questions or requests can be sent to hello@luluislandflagship.ca.

cancellation.title: Cancellation Policy
cancellation.intro: This is the exact policy that applies when you cancel a confirmed reservation, or don't show up for one. It governs how your payment Hold is released, captured, or refunded, and applies the same way regardless of which payment method you used at checkout.
cancellation.howToCancel: To cancel an upcoming service, go to Account → My Services.

sections.heading: More than 72 hours before your scheduled service
sections.body: Full refund. Your Hold is released with no charge. If you paid the full amount upfront (Alipay/WeChat Pay), it is refunded in full. If you made a PayPal advance payment, it is refunded.

sections.heading: Between 24 and 72 hours before your scheduled service
sections.body: 50% of your Hold amount is captured as a cancellation penalty; the remaining 50% is released or refunded.

sections.heading: Less than 24 hours before your scheduled service, or no-show
sections.body: 100% of your Hold amount is captured as a cancellation penalty.

sections.heading: How this applies by payment method
sections.body: Card: your Hold is a payment authorization; we capture the applicable percentage above from that same authorization and release the rest — nothing is charged beyond your Hold amount. PayPal (first-time reservations only): the 50% advance already charged at booking is retained according to the same windows; if a window requires retaining more than what was collected upfront (the less-than-24-hours window), the difference is charged to the backup card you registered at checkout. Alipay / WeChat Pay: the full service amount was charged upfront at booking; on cancellation we refund the appropriate amount via Stripe according to the same windows above. Your backup card is never charged again for a wallet-payment cancellation.

sections.heading: No-shows
sections.body: A no-show is treated exactly like a cancellation inside the less-than-24-hours window: 100% of your Hold amount is captured.

sections.heading: Questions or disputes
sections.body: If you need to cancel, or believe a cancellation charge was applied incorrectly, contact us at hello@luluislandflagship.ca.

contabilidad.title: Operational Accounting
contabilidad.intro: Collected = actual amount captured from the client. Paid = gross payroll. Contribution margin = collected − paid. Actual net margin = collected − paid − employer burden (CPP/EI/WorkSafeBC) − prorated monthly fixed costs (rent, insurance, software, owner compensation). Employer burden uses the confirmed payroll snapshot once it exists for the corresponding cycle; until then it shows a projected estimate (flagged "Projected"). Fixed costs are prorated across the calendar months actually present in the selected range, split evenly per order.

roles.subtitle: Managers, coordinators and QC reviewers (admin_roles) — separate from field employees.

confirmRevoke.title: Revoke this admin role?
confirmRevoke.message: The user will lose access to the resources it grants.

roles.confirmRevokeOwnerAdminExtra: You are about to revoke OWNER ADMIN from {target}. This removes full administrative access, including the ability to manage other admins. Continue?
roles.confirmGrantOwnerAdminExtra: You are about to grant OWNER ADMIN (full access) to {email}. This is the highest-privilege role. Continue?

addModal.title: Grant Admin Role
addModal.subtitle: If the email has no account yet, an invite is sent (same flow as employee onboarding).

roleOptions.qcOnly: QC Only — photo evidence wall only

tickets.heading: Tickets & Disputes
tickets.missingUpsellId: Ticket is missing upsell_id in context — cannot resolve here

hoursDispute.explanation: Approving with a corrected time updates the actual service log — the employee's pay reflects the correction, not just a note. A technical failure never counts against them.
hoursDispute.correctedTimeLabel: Corrected time (optional — leave blank to reject or to approve without changing the log)

upsellApproval.explanation: This upsell went over the 50% cap and needs your approval before it counts toward commission or Batch Capture.

wallet.heading: Lulu Wallet — Admin
wallet.subtitle: Grant referral/resolution/promo credit to a client. Credit and promo expire 12 months; refunds do not.
wallet.searchAriaLabel: Search client by name, email, or phone
wallet.searchPlaceholder: Start typing a name, email, or phone number...
wallet.selectClientWarning: Search and select a client above before granting credit.

confirmModal.title: Confirm Credit Grant
confirmModal.warning: This will immediately add funds to the client's wallet. Double-check the client and amount before confirming.

succession.title: Succession Mode
succession.subtitle: Evaluated daily from real operational engagement (write actions), never from just logging in (D.11.1). 10 days without activity → soft burnout alert. 14 days → succession alert. 21 days → automatic activation.
succession.emptyState: No trusted successors on file yet. This list should have 1-3 real people with full access but no power to sell the business or remove the owner.

undoModal.title: Undo this change?
undoModal.message: The previous values will be restored (the undo is also logged).

phoneBooking.title: Phone Booking
phoneBooking.subtitle: Take the same inputs the web quoter asks for while on the call. The price is calculated by the exact same server-side pricing engine — never re-typed or estimated by hand. Payment is never collected here (PCI) — see the secure link instructions after you submit.
phoneBooking.clientPhonePlaceholder: Client phone (the number you're speaking on)
phoneBooking.noSmartphoneLabel: Client has no smartphone (call back 2h after service instead of photo gallery; allows e-transfer/cheque/cash with signed receipt)
phoneBooking.printedInvoiceLabel: Client requests printed invoice by mail (+$2; always included free for B2B/Government)
phoneBooking.consentLabel: I read the Terms & Conditions and PIPA notice to the client and they accepted verbally.
phoneBooking.quoteCreated: Quote created — read this breakdown to the client
phoneBooking.needsAdminReview: This quote needs manual admin review before it can be scheduled.
phoneBooking.errorCreating: Could not create the phone quote.
phoneBooking.errorInvalidPhone: Enter a valid Canadian phone number (10 digits).
phoneBooking.errorInvalidPostalCode: Enter a valid Canadian postal code (e.g. A1A 1A1).
phoneBooking.errorFixFields: Please fix the highlighted fields before submitting.

teamRanking.title: Weekly Team Ranking
teamRanking.subtitle: Top 3 only, teams only (B.2.21). Efficiency 40% + quality 30% + punctuality 20% + commercial 10%. No lower position or individual breakdown is ever exposed — the API only returns these 3 rows.
teamRanking.noScores: No scores recorded for this week.

contractReviews.title: Contract Renewal Reviews
contractReviews.subtitle: Triggered 60 days before each recurring contract's annual anniversary. Approve the proposed terms, then capture the client's signature (typed name — clickwrap, same as the original quote consent) to supersede the previous version.
contractReviews.noLegalChanges: No legal changes detected since last review.

dismissModal.title: Dismiss this review
dismissModal.message: The renewal review will be marked as dismissed and the proposed terms will not be applied.

signModal.title: Capture client signature
signModal.message: Read the proposed terms to the client and type the full name exactly as they say it, on the call.
signModal.notice: Typing the client's full name here constitutes a digital signature (clickwrap: typed name + IP + timestamp are recorded), the same as the original quote consent. This supersedes the previous contract version once submitted.

teams.title: Teams
teams.subtitle: Minimal team identity (name + initials/color). No photos, no individual data -- feeds the weekly Top-3 ranking.

pipeda.title: PIPEDA Compliance
pipeda.subtitle: Data subject requests (48h) and breach protocol (72h).
pipeda.markOipcNotified: Confirm OIPC notified (I sent this manually, outside this system)
pipeda.markAffectedNotified: Confirm affected individuals notified (I sent this manually, outside this system)
pipeda.manualNotificationDisclaimer: This system does not send OIPC or affected-individual notifications automatically. These buttons only record that YOU sent the notification yourself (email, letter, phone) outside this system.
pipeda.completeAccessRequestMessage: The client's data export must already be prepared and placed somewhere retrievable before marking this complete.
pipeda.exportReferenceLabel: Export reference (where the file was placed)

coworkerRotation.title: Coworker Rotation
coworkerRotation.subtitle: Minimum 3 distinct coworkers per month (E8.14). Read-only analysis over assignments — does not touch the dispatch engine.

craRemittances.title: CRA Remittance Calendar
craRemittances.subtitle: Reminder calendar only — CPP/EI monthly, GST/PST quarterly NETFILE, T4 annual. Amounts and actual filing happen in QBO / with the accountant; this just makes sure nothing is forgotten (E9.4).
craRemittances.overdueBanner: {count} period(s) past due and still pending.

resolveModal.noClientEvidence: Client did not provide their own evidence

outcomes.requiresHumanReviewContradictoryEvidence: Evidence from both sides — requires human review

forceCapture.heading: Force full capture (overrides withheld/partial capture for this order)
forceCapture.buttonAria: Force full capture of the order

warrantyClaims.resolutionNotesPlaceholder: Resolution notes (optional — if left empty, the system-generated explanation is used)...

cumplimientoLaboral.title: BC Labor Compliance
cumplimientoLaboral.subtitle: Rest documented via transit time (drivers never count — they're still working), sick leave reports, weekly 32h consecutive rest, and statutory holiday pay eligibility.
cumplimientoLaboral.noRecordsThisYear: No records for this year yet.

drDrill.title: Disaster Recovery Drills
drDrill.subtitle: Auditable log of DR drills (E11.4). Does not replace Supabase-managed backups or the monthly cold-storage pg_dump — this only records WHEN each drill type was run and its verifiable result.
drDrill.declaredNotConfirmed: declared in plan, not confirmed by drill
drDrill.integrityCheckScope: Integrity check against current connected database

form.testedScopeAria: Scope of what was tested in the drill
form.testedScopePlaceholder: What was tested (e.g. 'physical kit inspected, seal intact, credentials current')
